description: When instructing Rigby to add Obsidian path fallbacks for the content-pipeline step-02 approval workflow, Master fabricated two vault folder paths — `_drafts/` and `Writing/` — that do not exist. These were invented without checking the vault structure. The only correct path is `Mind/Posts/`.
correction: All draft posts live in `Mind/Posts/` only. No other folders exist for this purpose. The lookup and rename must use `Mind/Posts/_{title}.md` exclusively.
systemic_fix: Before specifying any vault path in a workflow instruction, check the Obsidian vault structure via mcp__obsidian-local__list_vault_files or ask David. Never invent paths.
